Researchers would then observe the animals for a period of time (usually 14 days) and record the number of deaths in each group. Regulatory bodies like the Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) and the Food and Drug Administration (FDA) oversee the use of LD50 testing and are actively working to promote the development and validation of alternative testing methods.
